name: Erica Gregory
source:
Erica is beautiful, ambitious and driven.

She may have some of the smallest boobs around, but that doesn't stop her from using her minimal resources to become a smart, successful business woman, despite her young age.

A money making genius, Erica uses her small talents to big effect, scamming perverted men online in ever more elaborate schemes.

If only she could get some privacy from her nosy sister, [url=/c127543]Katie Gregory[/url], who has started to notice her not so savory money making methods...
